summary: Adds standalone local parametric CAD with exact modelling, geometry exchange and shared human/agent workflows connected to CAM.
warning: Installed post packages, saved CAM revisions, post execution events and controller output contracts are unchanged. CAD handoff creates a new detached CAM project; review its contours, threading and machining setup before generating output. A numerical roundoff correction can classify freshly calculated nearly tangent intersections differently; existing saved geometry and output are not rewritten. Exact section transfer refuses unsupported or ambiguous curves instead of approximating them.

checklist.schema: App version advances once to 0.0.697. New CAD document and save-envelope schemas start independently at version 1. UPID, post, package, engine API and existing workbench schemas are unchanged. CAD saves live in the additive cad/documents namespace.
checklist.events: Post execution-event contracts, compilation, audit and invocation are unchanged. CAD uses its own immutable versioned draft and bounded history. Handoff validates analytic millimetre geometry through the ordinary portable-UPID import operation.
checklist.capabilities: Installed post capability claims are unchanged. Desktop CAD adds automatic sketch regions, analytic imported paths, STEP and closed STL import, selective fillets/chamfers, planar-face inward shells, exact topology inspection, Boolean operations and parametric history. Versioned WebMCP tools reuse the same import, edit, build, selection, save and handoff checks.
checklist.auditAndOutput: Existing controller formatting, feed policy and exact-post output remain authoritative. CAD JSON preserves editable history; STEP exports exact BRep, STL exports a mesh, and sketch DXF preserves analytic curves. Failed solid features block solid export. Sketch and solid-section handoffs create separate CAM projects without overwriting prior revisions.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No migration or installed-package rewrite. CAD storage covers browser cache and folder adapters with exact hash conflicts, journal recovery and write-boundary guards. Full workbench backup includes CAD files; cleanup retains the entire CAD namespace. CAD save and CAM creation are separate commits. The lazy OpenCascade worker is distributed with pinned corresponding sources and rebuild instructions.
checklist.verification: Independent numerical, kernel, storage, UI and agent-boundary review; latest complete Vitest verification: 240 files / 2,446 tests pass across both projects with four workers. Full production Chromium: 100 pass, one existing externally seeded-workbench case skipped. Production TypeScript/build, 29 documentation pages / 92 checked files, generated post contract parity, UPID conformance, pinned CAD/STEP corresponding-source distribution and release gate pass. The first checkpoint also verified all three unchanged Robofil 2.6.0 post fixtures and complete machine-package validation; current browser coverage includes ordinary installation and controller export. Native WebMCP builds and measures a parameterized plate, inspects exact faces, resolves its planar opening and captures the corrected sketch view. Production tests cover real face picking, selected chamfer, shell, STEP/STL/DXF import-export round trips, save/reload and detached sketch/section CAM handoff. See the CAD checkpoint review for evidence and limits. No physical controller verification is claimed.

testedPosts.scope: Unchanged post passes all three conformance fixtures and complete machine-package validation. CAD does not bypass the existing saved-revision, active-setup or audited output requirements. No physical controller verification is claimed.

publicNotes.summary: Design parametric parts and send exact contours into the machining workbench.
changes: Design in CAD opens a desktop workspace with one compact document header, feature tree, dimension editor, sketch canvas, solid viewport and history timeline.

Create dimension-driven sketches with automatic material nesting and exact solids with pads, revolves, Booleans, selected-edge fillets/chamfers, inward shells, transforms, mirrors and patterns. Reuse named parameters in dimension expressions.
Send a sketch or previewed final-solid section directly into a new CAM project with analytic lines and circular arcs.
Save editable CAD documents locally; import and export CAD JSON, STEP, STL and sketch DXF. Imported originals remain in the document. Capture the visible sketch or solid as PNG.
Agents can discover schemas, import geometry, edit the same draft, inspect exact faces and edges, control the viewport, save and hand off designs through version-checked WebMCP tools.
publicNotes.compatibility: Installed posts, saved CAM revisions and controller output contracts are unchanged. CAD transfers create detached CAM projects. Fresh near-tangent intersection calculations include a numerical roundoff correction; saved files are not rewritten.
publicNotes.action: Choose Design in CAD, create or import a part, then use File > Send to CAM for a sketch or File > Section for CAM for the finished solid. Review the resulting machining plan before output.
